description: English vendor ESD test model chunk.
text: Texas Instruments application notes describe several electrostatic discharge test models used to qualify semiconductor devices. The Human Body Model (HBM) simulates a charged person touching an integrated circuit, while the Charged Device Model (CDM) simulates a charged device discharging when it contacts a grounded surface. IEC 61000-4-2 is commonly used for system-level ESD immunity testing and defines contact discharge and air discharge test methods. Device-level qualification is often performed before board-level validation, and PCB layout, grounding, and transient voltage suppressor (TVS) devices are used to improve ESD robustness.
